packing: The fixed-size input atlases repeat our existing inspected idle crops without rescaling. Each generated sheet is calibrated once with its existing idle body scale, never by each pose's total height. The battle-sized sequence atlases pack those new cells with the exact existing grounded quiet poses. Their cutter scale is 1 and their common absolute foot anchor is 64,124 in each 128-pixel cell. The low-sum packed background is outside the game's palette and cannot be mistaken for a shadow or erase grey armour pixels.
